organon.summary: Sun Pharma is buying Organon, a women's-health company, for about $11.75bn enterprise value ($14 a share, all cash), funded with about $2-2.5bn of cash and about $9.25-9.75bn of debt. Close expected in Q4 FY27, leverage about 2.3x net debt/EBITDA. Organon CY26 sales about $6.2bn, EBITDA about $1.92bn.
organon.why_it_matters: It turns a net-cash company (net cash $3.3bn) into a levered one, so a beta measured on the old balance sheet understates the new risk. Hamada gives roughly 14% higher equity beta (our rough estimate). Nirmal Bang and Nuvama leave it out of their estimates, so their targets do not price it either.
